2610.07627.title: Learning to Outgrow a Theory: Experimental Discovery Beyond the Initial Hypothesis Space
2610.07627.paper_summary: Scientific discovery systems typically optimize experiments within a fixed hypothesis space. This creates a failure mode when all available candidates omit the same missing mechanism: candidate disagreement can collapse even while the model class is systematically wrong. We formulate experimental model-class revision, in which a discovery policy jointly proposes a structural edit and a diagnostic experiment that tests whether that edit is necessary. The method couples a class-level distinguishability objective, in which one shared parameterization must explain all selected experiments, with anytime-valid sequential evidence that triggers structural revision only after the current class is rejected. On 400 held-out controlled dynamical environments, the joint policy reaches 89.5% exact recovery with a budget of 32 real experiments, improving the strongest matched baseline by 10.0 percentage points while requiring fewer executed experiments and candidate fits. The learned revision-experiment pairing transfers across unseen mechanism combinations, held-out but expressible primitives, parameter extrapolation, and shifted experiment costs; when the true mechanism is outside the edit grammar, it detects library insufficiency in 88% of cases with a 5.5% false-support rate. Revision gains also transfer to ODEBench and ODEBase model-library tasks, as well as DiscoverPhysics worlds. These results support a view of scientific discovery in which deciding what mechanisms a theory should make expressible and where to collect evidence are treated as a single sequential decision problem.
2610.07627.paper_summary_zh: 科學發現系統通常在固定的假設空間內優化實驗。這會產生一種失敗模式，當所有可用的候選者都忽略相同的缺失機制時：候選者之間的分歧即使在模型類別系統性錯誤的情況下也可能崩潰。我們制定了實驗模型類別修訂的方案，其中發現政策共同提出結構編輯和診斷實驗，以測試該編輯是否必要。該方法結合了一個類別級的可區分性目標，其中一個共享的參數化必須解釋所有選定的實驗，並且具有隨時有效的序列證據，該證據僅在當前類別被拒絕後觸發結構修訂。在400個保留的受控動態環境中，聯合政策在32次真實實驗的預算下達到了89.5%的精確恢復，將最強匹配基準提高了10.0個百分點，同時需要更少的執行實驗和候選擬合。學習到的修訂-實驗配對在未見的機制組合、保留但可表達的原始元素、參數外推和變更的實驗成本中轉移；當真實機制超出編輯語法時，它在88%的情況下檢測到庫的不足，假陽性支持率為5.5%。修訂增益也轉移到ODEBench和ODEBase模型庫任務，以及DiscoverPhysics世界。這些結果支持一種科學發現的觀點，即決定理論應該使哪些機制可表達以及在哪裡收集證據被視為一個單一的序列決策問題。
